verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation documents a built-in one-switch dark mode toggle, which gives an instant light/dark restyle but not a choice among multiple built-in themes. A community report notes some Flatpak apps ignore the distro theme, which weakens the 'whole desktop' claim. Missing for 10: a selection of more than two built-in themes, evidence that a theme change restyles every app and shell element, and hands-on corroboration of theme switching.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can instantly switch between multiple built-in visual themes that restyle the whole desktop

citations.quote: Flip a switch to turn on dark mode and give your eyes a break.
